Renshaw's unbeaten 190 puts Australia in strong test position

Matt Renshaw scored a career-best unbeaten 190, helping Australia take control of the first test against South Africa. On the second day at Kingsmead in Durban, Renshaw and Nathan Lyon shared a record ninth-wicket stand of 134, with Australia reaching 390 for nine by tea. Renshaw's performance put Australia in a strong position.
